method.name: create
method.description: Creates an object of the class, like [code]create[/code] in GD++ code.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Frees [param object] right away, like [code]destroy[/code] in GD++ code. Does nothing for [code]null[/code]. It's thread-safe: on other threads than the main one, it leaves nodes in the scene tree to the main thread, which frees them at the end of the frame.

method.name: queue_destroy
method.description: Frees [param object] at the end of the frame, like [code]queue_destroy[/code] in GD++ code, and [method Node.queue_free]. Does nothing for [code]null[/code].
